ignoreValues.reason: Detector cannot resolve CSS custom-property padding (var(--sp-*) via calc()) on .notice/.run-status/.compose-box; verified via Playwright getComputedStyle: .notice=16px, .run-status=12/16px, .compose-box=8/8/8/16px, all real insets. .tab-card is the padded-children shape: 0 padding on the wrapper itself, but its only text-bearing child (.tab-card-foot) carries its own 12/16px padding, and .tab-card-shot has no text against its edge.
img#tab-card-icon starts hidden with no src by design; renderTabCard() in panel.js sets its src once a real tab favicon URL is known. Not an unfilled placeholder.

Two remaining 11px leaf texts, verified by rendering the built panel.html: #status-text (the run-status strip's live readout, e.g. 'ready'/'finished'/'waiting for your answer') and #tab-card-title (the tab-preview card's title, e.g. 'no tab yet'). Both are status/caption readouts, not body content the user reads at length and not an action hint — the textbook defensible case per the design's own type scale (--text-2xs: 11px reserved for captions/status, matching the Codex reference's --text-xs: 11px). Distinct from two other elements the same sweep DID fix: .composer-caption (#tab-context + the send-key hint) and .tab-card-foot's 'or type @ for another' hint, both bumped from 11px to the 12px functional floor because they are action hints, not captions.
